parent_objective: audit no-rollout task-quality calibration matrix before bounded smoke design
blocked_by: need audit before selecting bounded calibration smoke subset
supersedes: direct calibration rollout execution after M1702

public_gates: M1703 must audit M1702 artifacts counts contract checks and guardrails
M1703 must decide whether bounded calibration smoke design is admitted
M1703 must not execute rollout train replay PPO promote use private holdout or change actor inputs
M1703 must not claim controller-family ranking, paper-level evidence, private-holdout evidence, or level3 self-ID

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: audits the no-rollout calibration matrix before bounded smoke design
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: preflight audit only; no rollout, training, replay, PPO, promotion, private holdout, controller ranking, paper-level or level3 claim
stop_condition: stop if calibration artifacts are incomplete
stop if audit skips matrix scale/runtime risk
stop if audit routes directly to full matrix rollout
fallback_plan: route to bounded smoke design if preflight is clean
route to preflight repair if artifacts or contract checks fail
route to branch stop if matrix scale is unsuitable

admission_evidence: M1702 writes calibration matrix artifacts and summary
blocked_shortcuts: do not claim controller ranking or level3 self-identification
allowed_updates: M1703 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up bounded calibration smoke design manifest
next_stage_criteria: preflight artifacts and counts are audited

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: high; M1703 audits infrastructure only and cannot prove history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: audit must preserve L1, L2-current-tiled, L3-online, and L3-reset rows for later bounded calibration smoke
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If preflight matrix is too large or invalid, route to repair before execution.
allowed_claims: no rollout, no training, no replay, no PPO, no private-holdout, no promotion, no paper-level result or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: M1702 can be audited as a clean no-rollout calibration preflight and routed to bounded calibration smoke design.
success_criteria: next bounded smoke route is explicit
rollout execution training replay PPO promotion private holdout actor-input changes and level3 claims remain blocked
failure_criteria: audit ignores contract violations or matrix scale
audit routes directly to full 10368-cell rollout
environment rollout training replay PPO private holdout promotion or actor-input changes occur

commands.name: audit
commands.command: audit M1702 calibration preflight artifacts and write next-route decision

decision_rule: M1703 passes if it audits M1702 and routes to bounded calibration smoke design or repair without overclaiming.
